title: Use equilibrium loss under the original positive path law
statement: For B=AA^T>=0,C=tr(diag(Gamma)B),equal m imaginary-time bins and original stationary positive path law P,the discarded collective action R_m=.5sum||F_a-P_mF_a||_L2^2>=0 gives Z_m/Z=E_P exp(-R_m). Jensen plus the double commutator[F_a,[H,F_a]]=4sum_i Gamma_i A_ia^2 X_i yields0<=logZ-logZ_m<=beta^2 C/(3m),and periodic refinement beta^2 C(1/(3m)-1/(6m^2)). Arbitrary diagonal interactions drop out of this commutator. Both relative-entropy directions between classical path laws<=beta^2 C/(3m),so TV<=sqrt(beta^2 C/(6m)); this controls bounded path/basis marginals,not quantum density trace distance,state preparation or rare-event relative precision. Fixed-system1/m sharpness is not an algorithmic lower bound; Harris/Bogoliubov antecedents are credited.
